name: Advanced Cell Biology
description: Introduction to cell biology: central dogma, eukaryotic cellular organization, model systems for experimental cell biology, de novo synthesis of organelles versus templated replication, the cytoskeletal system, intracellular trafficking, the nucleus, the cellular movement: motility and contractility, extracellular structures, cell adhesions and cell junctions, optical imaging techniques in cell biology, live cell imaging, cancer biology, developmental biology.
